patches.expectedValueJson: "作名词时，bed 常指睡觉用的“床”，也可指花坛、河床或一层东西；作动词时，常表示让人上床睡觉或把植物栽进花坛。"
patches.valueJson: "先掌握名词“床”和 go to bed（去睡觉）；bed 也可指种植地、水底或承托的一层材料。动词 bed down 可表示安顿人过夜或自己睡下；栽种、铺设等动词义多见于特定语境。"

patches.expectedValueJson: "记住 go to bed 表示“去睡觉”，而 get into bed 强调“进入床里”。"

patches.expectedValueJson: "用 river bed 和 a bed of roses 体会 bed 从“供安放的地方”引申出的意思。"

patches.expectedValueJson: "练习动词 bed：bed the baby 和 bed the plants。"
patches.valueJson: "练习 bed someone down（安顿某人过夜）和 bed down（自己安顿睡下）；栽种义结合园艺表达 bed out seedlings 学习。"

patches.expectedValueJson: "以辅音字母 + e + d 结尾的重读短元音词，双写末尾 d 再加 -ed。"

patches.valueJson: {"id":"bed-noun-place-layer","title":"承托的一层材料","meaning":"铺在下方、供其他东西放置或承托其他东西的一层材料。","usageNote":"常用 a bed of 表示这一层由什么组成，后面既可接复数名词，如 leaves，也可接不可数名词，如 rice、sand。它常强调铺在下面的一层，不能替代所有表示“层”的 layer。","examples":[{"id":"bed-layer-example-1","senseId":"bed-noun-place-layer","en":"She served the fish on a bed of rice.","zh":"她把鱼放在铺好的米饭上端了出来。","note":"a bed of rice 指铺在鱼下面的一层米饭；rice 是不可数名词。"},{"id":"bed-layer-example-2","senseId":"bed-noun-place-layer","en":"The dog curled up on a bed of dry leaves.","zh":"狗蜷在一层干树叶上。","note":"树叶铺成供狗躺卧的一层。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"a bed of + 不可数名词或复数名词","zh":"由……铺成的承托层","note":"如 a bed of sand 或 a bed of leaves。","kind":"sentence-pattern"},{"en":"serve X on a bed of Y","zh":"把食物 X 放在铺好的 Y 上端上桌","note":"常见于描述菜肴的摆放。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"a bed of rice","zh":"铺在下面的一层米饭","note":"常用于描述菜肴下面垫着米饭。","kind":"common-collocation"},{"en":"a bed of sand","zh":"一层垫沙","note":"可指承托石板等物体的沙层。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"layer","zh":"层","note":"layer 适用范围更广；bed 在这里强调铺在下面、起承托作用的一层。"}],"contrasting":[],"similarNote":"谈承托材料时，bed 与 layer 意思接近；但 a layer of paint（一层油漆）通常不能直接改成 a bed of paint。","contrastingNote":"这一具体名词义没有常用的一一对应反义词。"},"sourceIds":["etymonline-bed"]}

patches.expectedValueJson: {"id":"bed-verb","title":"安顿上床；栽种","meaning":"使人上床睡觉；把植物栽进花坛或苗床。","usageNote":"bed someone down 可表示安顿某人睡下；bed plants 通常指把植物种进花坛或苗床。","examples":[{"id":"bed-example-5","senseId":"bed-verb","en":"Mum bedded the baby after his bath.","zh":"宝宝洗完澡后，妈妈把他安顿上床睡觉。","note":"bedded 是 bed 的过去式。"},{"id":"bed-example-6","senseId":"bed-verb","en":"We bedded the young trees along the fence.","zh":"我们把小树苗栽在篱笆旁。","note":"这里 bed 表示把植物栽入土中。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"bed someone down","zh":"安顿某人上床睡觉","note":"可用于安排孩子或客人睡下。","kind":"sentence-pattern"},{"en":"bed plants in a flower bed","zh":"把植物栽进花坛","note":"bed 后可直接接植物。","kind":"sentence-pattern"},{"en":"bed down for the night","zh":"安顿下来过夜","note":"bed down 也可指找地方睡下。","kind":"fixed-expression"}],"collocations":[{"en":"bed the baby","zh":"把宝宝安顿上床","note":"bed 作及物动词，后接人。","kind":"common-collocation"},{"en":"bed roses","zh":"栽种玫瑰","note":"bed 作及物动词，后接植物。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"put someone to bed","zh":"让某人上床睡觉","note":"日常表达，常用于照顾孩子；比 bed someone 更常见。"},{"en":"plant","zh":"种植","note":"表示把植物种下，适用范围更广；bed 强调把植物安置在花坛或苗床中。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"get someone up","zh":"叫某人起床","note":"在人睡觉的语境中，与安顿上床方向相反。"}],"similarNote":"put someone to bed 是常见日常说法；bed someone down 也可表示安顿人睡下。plant 泛指种植。","contrastingNote":"仅在人睡觉的语境中，get someone up 表示叫人起床，与安顿上床方向相反。"},"sourceIds":["cambridge-bed"]}
patches.valueJson: {"id":"bed-verb","title":"安顿人过夜；自己睡下（bed down）","meaning":"为某人安排睡处，或自己在某处安顿下来睡觉。","usageNote":"bed someone down 是为人安排睡处，bed down 是自己找地方睡下。单独用 bed someone 表示“让人上床”较少见，且可能有性含义；照顾孩子时通常说 put someone to bed。","examples":[{"id":"bed-example-5","senseId":"bed-verb","en":"We bedded the children down in the spare room.","zh":"我们把孩子们安顿在备用房间里睡下。","note":"bed someone down 是及物用法，说明把谁安顿睡下。"},{"id":"bed-sleep-example-2","senseId":"bed-verb","en":"The stranded passengers were bedded down in a school gym.","zh":"滞留旅客被安顿在学校体育馆里过夜。","note":"这是被动用法，强调旅客获得了临时睡处。"},{"id":"bed-sleep-example-3","senseId":"bed-verb","en":"We bedded down in the village hall for the night.","zh":"我们当晚在村礼堂里安顿下来睡觉。","note":"这里的 bed down 不接宾语，表示自己睡下。"},{"id":"bed-sleep-example-4","senseId":"bed-verb","en":"The hikers bedded down beside the fire.","zh":"徒步旅行者们在火堆旁安顿下来睡觉。","note":"bed down 不要求有真正的床，也可指就地安排睡处。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"bed someone down + 地点状语","zh":"把某人安顿在某处睡下","note":"someone 是被安排睡处的人。","kind":"sentence-pattern"},{"en":"bed down + 地点状语","zh":"在某处安顿睡下","note":"不接人的宾语，由主语自己睡下。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"bed down for the night","zh":"安顿下来过夜","note":"常用于临时安排当晚的睡处。","kind":"fixed-expression"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"put someone to bed","zh":"让某人上床睡觉","note":"常用于照顾孩子或病人，侧重让人上床。"},{"en":"put someone up","zh":"为某人提供临时住宿","note":"强调提供住宿，不专门描述睡下的动作。"},{"en":"settle down for the night","zh":"安顿下来过夜","note":"与不及物的 bed down 接近。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"get someone up","zh":"叫某人起床","note":"与把某人安顿睡下形成方向对照。"},{"en":"get up","zh":"起床","note":"与自己安顿睡下形成方向对照。"}],"similarNote":"put someone to bed 多用于照顾他人；put someone up 强调临时住宿；bed down 常强调在某处安排睡处或睡下。","contrastingNote":"这些反向表达限定在就寝与起床的语境。"},"sourceIds":["wiktionary-bed-en"]}

{"id":"bed-noun-garden","title":"花坛；菜畦","meaning":"整理出来供花卉、蔬菜等植物生长的一小块土地。","usageNote":"种花的地方可说 flower bed，种菜的一畦地可说 vegetable bed。这里的 bed 不指睡觉用的家具。","examples":[{"id":"bed-example-3","senseId":"bed-noun-garden","en":"Grandpa planted roses in the flower bed.","zh":"爷爷把玫瑰种在花坛里。","note":"flower bed 指栽花的地方。"},{"id":"bed-garden-example-2","senseId":"bed-noun-garden","en":"I pulled weeds out of the vegetable bed.","zh":"我把菜畦里的杂草拔掉了。","note":"vegetable bed 指集中种菜的一畦地。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"a flower bed / a vegetable bed","zh":"花坛／菜畦","note":"前面的名词说明这块地种什么。","kind":"common-collocation"},{"en":"a bed of roses","zh":"安逸舒服的生活（习语）","note":"字面上也可指一畦玫瑰；作为习语时常用于否定句，如 Running a small shop isn't a bed of roses.（经营一家小店并不轻松。）","kind":"fixed-expression"}],"collocations":[{"en":"prepare a flower bed","zh":"整理花坛，为种花做准备","note":"可包括翻土、清理杂草等工作。","kind":"common-collocation"},{"en":"weed a vegetable bed","zh":"给菜畦除草","note":"weed 在这个搭配中是动词。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"garden plot","zh":"园圃中的一小块地","note":"也可指种植用的小块土地；plot 的范围比 bed 更广。"}],"contrasting":[],"similarNote":"garden plot 与 bed 在种植语境中接近；bed 常强调整理好、集中种植的一畦地。","contrastingNote":"这一具体地块名称没有常用的一一对应反义词。"},"sourceIds":["wiktionary-bed-en"]}

{"id":"bed-noun-bottom","title":"河床；水底","meaning":"河、溪、湖或海等水体底部的地面。","usageNote":"可说 the bed of a river，也可说 river bed 或 riverbed；sea bed 和 seabed 都表示海底。","examples":[{"id":"bed-example-4","senseId":"bed-noun-bottom","en":"The river bed was dry after weeks without rain.","zh":"好几个星期没下雨后，河床干了。","note":"river bed 指河流底部。"},{"id":"bed-bottom-example-2","senseId":"bed-noun-bottom","en":"The diver picked up a shell from the sea bed.","zh":"潜水员从海底捡起一个贝壳。","note":"sea bed 指海水下面的地面。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"the bed of a river","zh":"河床","note":"bed 在这里指河水下面的地面。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"collocations":[{"en":"river bed / riverbed","zh":"河床","note":"既有分写形式，也有合写形式。","kind":"common-collocation"},{"en":"sea bed / seabed","zh":"海底；海床","note":"两种写法均可见。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"bottom","zh":"底部","note":"范围更广；在 river bottom 等水体表达中，与 bed 意思接近。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"the surface of the water","zh":"水面","note":"在水体方位上与水底形成对照。"}],"similarNote":"bottom 可指各种东西的底部；bed 在本义中专指水体下面的地面。","contrastingNote":"这里比较水面与水底的位置，不把 surface 当作 bed 其他词义的反义词。"},"sourceIds":["etymonline-bed"]}

{"id":"bed-verb-plant","title":"栽入花坛或苗床；移栽","meaning":"把植物栽入准备好的土壤或种植地；bed out 可表示把幼苗移栽到室外。","usageNote":"这是园艺用法。泛指种植物时通常用 plant；bed 更强调把植物安置在花坛、苗床等种植地中。","examples":[{"id":"bed-example-6","senseId":"bed-verb-plant","en":"We bedded out the seedlings after the last frost.","zh":"最后一场霜冻过后，我们把幼苗移栽到了室外。","note":"bed out 表示把幼苗移栽到室外的种植地。"},{"id":"bed-plant-example-2","senseId":"bed-verb-plant","en":"The gardener bedded the pansies in fresh soil.","zh":"园丁把三色堇栽进了新土里。","note":"bed 后直接接植物，in 后说明栽种的位置或材料。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"bed plants in + 地点或土壤","zh":"把植物栽进某处或某种土壤","note":"及物用法，plants 是宾语。","kind":"sentence-pattern"},{"en":"bed out seedlings","zh":"把幼苗移栽到室外","note":"常用于描述育苗后的移栽。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"bed out young plants","zh":"把幼株移栽到室外","note":"园艺语境中的表达。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"plant","zh":"种植","note":"范围更广，可用于种树、播种等多种种植活动。"},{"en":"plant out","zh":"移栽到室外","note":"在幼苗移栽的语境中与 bed out 接近。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"uproot","zh":"连根拔起","note":"在把植物栽进土里的语境中，与移出植物形成方向对照。"}],"similarNote":"一般种植优先掌握 plant；谈幼苗移栽时，plant out 与 bed out 意思接近。","contrastingNote":"uproot 只与本义的栽入土中形成对照，不对应 bed 的其他用法。"},"sourceIds":["wiktionary-bed-en"]}

{"id":"bed-noun-geology","title":"煤层等地层或矿层","meaning":"岩石、煤等沉积物形成的一个层位。","note":"地质或采矿用语；煤层可说 a bed of coal 或 a coal bed。","example":{"id":"bed-geology-example-1","senseId":"bed-noun-geology","en":"The tunnel passes through a thin bed of coal.","zh":"这条隧道穿过一层薄煤层。","note":"这里的 bed 指煤形成的地层。"},"sourceIds":["wiktionary-bed-en","etymonline-bed"]}

{"id":"bed-noun-base","title":"机器底座；机床床身","meaning":"机器中承托、固定其他部件的坚固基座，如车床的床身。","note":"机械专业用语，常见于 machine bed、lathe bed 等表达。","example":{"id":"bed-base-example-1","senseId":"bed-noun-base","en":"The lathe has a heavy cast-iron bed.","zh":"这台车床有一个沉重的铸铁床身。","note":"bed 在这里指承托车床其他部件的结构。"},"sourceIds":[]}

{"id":"bed-noun-roadbed","title":"路基","meaning":"承托道路路面或铁路轨道的基础层。","note":"交通工程用语；也常见合成词 roadbed。","example":{"id":"bed-roadbed-example-1","senseId":"bed-noun-roadbed","en":"The flood washed away part of the railway bed.","zh":"洪水冲走了一部分铁路路基。","note":"railway bed 指轨道下面起承托作用的路基。"},"sourceIds":[]}

{"id":"bed-verb-intransitive-settle","title":"沉实；贴合稳固（不及物）","meaning":"材料逐渐沉实、形成稳固的一层，或机器部件逐渐贴合、磨合。","note":"常与 down 或 in 连用。bed down 可描述铺地材料沉实；bed in 可描述部件磨合，如 new brake pads bed in（新刹车片磨合）。","example":{"id":"bed-settle-example-1","senseId":"bed-verb-intransitive-settle","en":"The gravel will bed down over time.","zh":"这些碎石会随着时间推移逐渐沉实。","note":"这里没有宾语，是碎石本身逐渐沉降、稳定下来。"},"sourceIds":["wiktionary-bed-en"]}

issues.message: Cambridge 页面未成功取得内容，不能据此归属具体释义、搭配和词族说明。改用已取得的法语维基词典英语词条；没有对应来源内容的引用置空。
花坛、河床和承托层合并后，各义例句不足，承托层完全没有例句。应分义补足；a bed of 后也能接 rice、sand 等不可数名词，不能限定为复数名词。
把较少见的 bed the baby、bed trees 当作初中日常默认表达，缺少语域说明；安顿睡下与栽种也各只有一例。原句不属于语法错误，但教学示范应突出 bed down，另列园艺义并分别补足例句。
遗漏词条中的底座、路基及不及物的沉实或机械贴合义；煤层义也未明确说明。应作为专业或较少见用法补入。
get into bed 的“进入床里”不自然；双写规则应说明本词的重读闭音节条件；bedtime 是合成词，不宜作为搭配项目。
school nights 指第二天要上学的晚上，译成“上学日”不够精确。

patches.expectedValueJson: "作名词时，bed 常指睡觉用的“床”，也可指花坛、河床或一层东西；作动词时，常表示让人上床睡觉或把植物栽进花坛。"
patches.valueJson: "先掌握名词“床”和 go to bed（去睡觉）；bed 也可指种植地、水底或承托的一层材料。动词 bed down 可表示安顿人过夜或自己睡下；栽种、铺设等动词义多见于特定语境。"

patches.expectedValueJson: "记住 go to bed 表示“去睡觉”，而 get into bed 强调“进入床里”。"
patches.valueJson: "记住 go to bed 表示“上床睡觉”，get into bed 更强调上床躺下或钻进被窝的动作；两者都不保证当时已经睡着。"

patches.expectedValueJson: "用 river bed 和 a bed of roses 体会 bed 从“供安放的地方”引申出的意思。"
patches.valueJson: "用 flower bed、river bed 和 a bed of rice 分别练习“种植地”“水底”和“承托的一层”。"

patches.expectedValueJson: "练习动词 bed：bed the baby 和 bed the plants。"

patches.expectedValueJson: {"id":"bed-noun-place-layer","title":"花坛；河床；一层","meaning":"指供植物生长的花坛，河流或海洋的底部，或铺放、沉积的一层东西。","usageNote":"常见搭配有 a flower bed（花坛）、the river bed（河床）和 a bed of leaves（一层树叶）。具体意思看后面的名词。","examples":[{"id":"bed-example-3","senseId":"bed-noun-place-layer","en":"Grandpa planted roses in the flower bed.","zh":"爷爷把玫瑰种在花坛里。","note":"flower bed 指栽花的地方。"},{"id":"bed-example-4","senseId":"bed-noun-place-layer","en":"The river bed was dry after weeks without rain.","zh":"好几个星期没下雨后，河床干了。","note":"river bed 指河流底部。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"a flower bed","zh":"花坛","note":"指种花的一片土地。","kind":"common-collocation"},{"en":"the bed of a river","zh":"河床","note":"也常说 river bed。","kind":"common-collocation"},{"en":"a bed of + 复数名词","zh":"一层……","note":"常指某物铺成或堆成的一层。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"a bed of snow","zh":"一层积雪","note":"描述覆盖在地面上的雪层。","kind":"common-collocation"},{"en":"the seabed","zh":"海床","note":"sea + bed 合成的词，指海底。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"bottom","zh":"底部","note":"一般指某物的最低部分；river bed 特指河流底部。"},{"en":"layer","zh":"层","note":"指覆盖或叠放的一层；a bed of leaves 可强调铺在地上的一层。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"surface","zh":"表面","note":"在河流语境中，surface 指水面，river bed 指河底。"}],"similarNote":"bottom 和 layer 更宽泛；bed 常见于河流底部、花坛或某种铺成的一层等具体语境。","contrastingNote":"只在水体方位上对照：surface 是水面，bed 是水底。"},"sourceIds":["cambridge-bed"]}
patches.valueJson: {"id":"bed-noun-place-layer","title":"承托的一层材料","meaning":"铺在下方、供其他东西放置或承托其他东西的一层材料。","usageNote":"常用 a bed of 表示这一层由什么组成，后面既可接复数名词，如 leaves，也可接不可数名词，如 rice、sand。它常强调铺在下面的一层，不能替代所有表示“层”的 layer。","examples":[{"id":"bed-layer-example-1","senseId":"bed-noun-place-layer","en":"She served the fish on a bed of rice.","zh":"她把鱼放在铺好的米饭上端了出来。","note":"a bed of rice 指铺在鱼下面的一层米饭；rice 是不可数名词。"},{"id":"bed-layer-example-2","senseId":"bed-noun-place-layer","en":"The dog curled up on a bed of dry leaves.","zh":"狗蜷在一层干树叶上。","note":"树叶铺成供狗躺卧的一层。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"a bed of + 不可数名词或复数名词","zh":"由……铺成的承托层","note":"如 a bed of sand 或 a bed of leaves。","kind":"sentence-pattern"},{"en":"serve X on a bed of Y","zh":"把食物 X 放在铺好的 Y 上端上桌","note":"常见于描述菜肴的摆放。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"a bed of rice","zh":"铺在下面的一层米饭","note":"常用于描述菜肴下面垫着米饭。","kind":"common-collocation"},{"en":"a bed of sand","zh":"一层垫沙","note":"可指承托石板等物体的沙层。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"layer","zh":"层","note":"layer 适用范围更广；bed 在这里强调铺在下面、起承托作用的一层。"}],"contrasting":[],"similarNote":"谈承托材料时，bed 与 layer 意思接近；但 a layer of paint（一层油漆）通常不能直接改成 a bed of paint。","contrastingNote":"这一具体名词义没有常用的一一对应反义词。"},"sourceIds":["etymonline-bed"]}

patches.expectedValueJson: {"id":"bed-verb","title":"安顿上床；栽种","meaning":"使人上床睡觉；把植物栽进花坛或苗床。","usageNote":"bed someone down 可表示安顿某人睡下；bed plants 通常指把植物种进花坛或苗床。","examples":[{"id":"bed-example-5","senseId":"bed-verb","en":"Mum bedded the baby after his bath.","zh":"宝宝洗完澡后，妈妈把他安顿上床睡觉。","note":"bedded 是 bed 的过去式。"},{"id":"bed-example-6","senseId":"bed-verb","en":"We bedded the young trees along the fence.","zh":"我们把小树苗栽在篱笆旁。","note":"这里 bed 表示把植物栽入土中。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"bed someone down","zh":"安顿某人上床睡觉","note":"可用于安排孩子或客人睡下。","kind":"sentence-pattern"},{"en":"bed plants in a flower bed","zh":"把植物栽进花坛","note":"bed 后可直接接植物。","kind":"sentence-pattern"},{"en":"bed down for the night","zh":"安顿下来过夜","note":"bed down 也可指找地方睡下。","kind":"fixed-expression"}],"collocations":[{"en":"bed the baby","zh":"把宝宝安顿上床","note":"bed 作及物动词，后接人。","kind":"common-collocation"},{"en":"bed roses","zh":"栽种玫瑰","note":"bed 作及物动词，后接植物。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"put someone to bed","zh":"让某人上床睡觉","note":"日常表达，常用于照顾孩子；比 bed someone 更常见。"},{"en":"plant","zh":"种植","note":"表示把植物种下，适用范围更广；bed 强调把植物安置在花坛或苗床中。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"get someone up","zh":"叫某人起床","note":"在人睡觉的语境中，与安顿上床方向相反。"}],"similarNote":"put someone to bed 是常见日常说法；bed someone down 也可表示安顿人睡下。plant 泛指种植。","contrastingNote":"仅在人睡觉的语境中，get someone up 表示叫人起床，与安顿上床方向相反。"},"sourceIds":["cambridge-bed"]}
patches.valueJson: {"id":"bed-verb","title":"安顿人过夜；自己睡下（bed down）","meaning":"为某人安排睡处，或自己在某处安顿下来睡觉。","usageNote":"bed someone down 是为人安排睡处，bed down 是自己找地方睡下。单独用 bed someone 表示“让人上床”较少见，且可能有性含义；照顾孩子时通常说 put someone to bed。","examples":[{"id":"bed-example-5","senseId":"bed-verb","en":"We bedded the children down in the spare room.","zh":"我们把孩子们安顿在备用房间里睡下。","note":"bed someone down 是及物用法，说明把谁安顿睡下。"},{"id":"bed-sleep-example-2","senseId":"bed-verb","en":"The stranded passengers were bedded down in a school gym.","zh":"滞留旅客被安顿在学校体育馆里过夜。","note":"这是被动用法，强调旅客获得了临时睡处。"},{"id":"bed-sleep-example-3","senseId":"bed-verb","en":"We bedded down in the village hall for the night.","zh":"我们当晚在村礼堂里安顿下来睡觉。","note":"这里的 bed down 不接宾语，表示自己睡下。"},{"id":"bed-sleep-example-4","senseId":"bed-verb","en":"The hikers bedded down beside the fire.","zh":"徒步旅行者们在火堆旁安顿下来睡觉。","note":"bed down 不要求有真正的床，也可指就地安排睡处。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"bed someone down + 地点状语","zh":"把某人安顿在某处睡下","note":"someone 是被安排睡处的人。","kind":"sentence-pattern"},{"en":"bed down + 地点状语","zh":"在某处安顿睡下","note":"不接人的宾语，由主语自己睡下。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"bed down for the night","zh":"安顿下来过夜","note":"常用于临时安排当晚的睡处。","kind":"fixed-expression"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"put someone to bed","zh":"让某人上床睡觉","note":"常用于照顾孩子或病人，侧重让人上床。"},{"en":"put someone up","zh":"为某人提供临时住宿","note":"强调提供住宿，不专门描述睡下的动作。"},{"en":"settle down for the night","zh":"安顿下来过夜","note":"与不及物的 bed down 接近。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"get someone up","zh":"叫某人起床","note":"与把某人安顿睡下形成方向对照。"},{"en":"get up","zh":"起床","note":"与自己安顿睡下形成方向对照。"}],"similarNote":"put someone to bed 多用于照顾他人；put someone up 强调临时住宿；bed down 常强调在某处安排睡处或睡下。","contrastingNote":"这些反向表达限定在就寝与起床的语境。"},"sourceIds":["wiktionary-bed-en"]}

{"id":"bed-noun-garden","title":"花坛；菜畦","meaning":"整理出来供花卉、蔬菜等植物生长的一小块土地。","usageNote":"种花的地方可说 flower bed，种菜的一畦地可说 vegetable bed。这里的 bed 不指睡觉用的家具。","examples":[{"id":"bed-example-3","senseId":"bed-noun-garden","en":"Grandpa planted roses in the flower bed.","zh":"爷爷把玫瑰种在花坛里。","note":"flower bed 指栽花的地方。"},{"id":"bed-garden-example-2","senseId":"bed-noun-garden","en":"I pulled weeds out of the vegetable bed.","zh":"我把菜畦里的杂草拔掉了。","note":"vegetable bed 指集中种菜的一畦地。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"a flower bed / a vegetable bed","zh":"花坛／菜畦","note":"前面的名词说明这块地种什么。","kind":"common-collocation"},{"en":"a bed of roses","zh":"安逸舒服的生活（习语）","note":"字面上也可指一畦玫瑰；作为习语时常用于否定句，如 Running a small shop isn't a bed of roses.（经营一家小店并不轻松。）","kind":"fixed-expression"}],"collocations":[{"en":"prepare a flower bed","zh":"整理花坛，为种花做准备","note":"可包括翻土、清理杂草等工作。","kind":"common-collocation"},{"en":"weed a vegetable bed","zh":"给菜畦除草","note":"weed 在这个搭配中是动词。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"garden plot","zh":"园圃中的一小块地","note":"也可指种植用的小块土地；plot 的范围比 bed 更广。"}],"contrasting":[],"similarNote":"garden plot 与 bed 在种植语境中接近；bed 常强调整理好、集中种植的一畦地。","contrastingNote":"这一具体地块名称没有常用的一一对应反义词。"},"sourceIds":["wiktionary-bed-en"]}

{"id":"bed-noun-bottom","title":"河床；水底","meaning":"河、溪、湖或海等水体底部的地面。","usageNote":"可说 the bed of a river，也可说 river bed 或 riverbed；sea bed 和 seabed 都表示海底。","examples":[{"id":"bed-example-4","senseId":"bed-noun-bottom","en":"The river bed was dry after weeks without rain.","zh":"好几个星期没下雨后，河床干了。","note":"river bed 指河流底部。"},{"id":"bed-bottom-example-2","senseId":"bed-noun-bottom","en":"The diver picked up a shell from the sea bed.","zh":"潜水员从海底捡起一个贝壳。","note":"sea bed 指海水下面的地面。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"the bed of a river","zh":"河床","note":"bed 在这里指河水下面的地面。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"collocations":[{"en":"river bed / riverbed","zh":"河床","note":"既有分写形式，也有合写形式。","kind":"common-collocation"},{"en":"sea bed / seabed","zh":"海底；海床","note":"两种写法均可见。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"bottom","zh":"底部","note":"范围更广；在 river bottom 等水体表达中，与 bed 意思接近。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"the surface of the water","zh":"水面","note":"在水体方位上与水底形成对照。"}],"similarNote":"bottom 可指各种东西的底部；bed 在本义中专指水体下面的地面。","contrastingNote":"这里比较水面与水底的位置，不把 surface 当作 bed 其他词义的反义词。"},"sourceIds":["etymonline-bed"]}

{"id":"bed-verb-plant","title":"栽入花坛或苗床；移栽","meaning":"把植物栽入准备好的土壤或种植地；bed out 可表示把幼苗移栽到室外。","usageNote":"这是园艺用法。泛指种植物时通常用 plant；bed 更强调把植物安置在花坛、苗床等种植地中。","examples":[{"id":"bed-example-6","senseId":"bed-verb-plant","en":"We bedded out the seedlings after the last frost.","zh":"最后一场霜冻过后，我们把幼苗移栽到了室外。","note":"bed out 表示把幼苗移栽到室外的种植地。"},{"id":"bed-plant-example-2","senseId":"bed-verb-plant","en":"The gardener bedded the pansies in fresh soil.","zh":"园丁把三色堇栽进了新土里。","note":"bed 后直接接植物，in 后说明栽种的位置或材料。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"bed plants in + 地点或土壤","zh":"把植物栽进某处或某种土壤","note":"及物用法，plants 是宾语。","kind":"sentence-pattern"},{"en":"bed out seedlings","zh":"把幼苗移栽到室外","note":"常用于描述育苗后的移栽。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"bed out young plants","zh":"把幼株移栽到室外","note":"园艺语境中的表达。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"plant","zh":"种植","note":"范围更广，可用于种树、播种等多种种植活动。"},{"en":"plant out","zh":"移栽到室外","note":"在幼苗移栽的语境中与 bed out 接近。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"uproot","zh":"连根拔起","note":"在把植物栽进土里的语境中，与移出植物形成方向对照。"}],"similarNote":"一般种植优先掌握 plant；谈幼苗移栽时，plant out 与 bed out 意思接近。","contrastingNote":"uproot 只与本义的栽入土中形成对照，不对应 bed 的其他用法。"},"sourceIds":["wiktionary-bed-en"]}

{"id":"bed-noun-geology","title":"煤层等地层或矿层","meaning":"岩石、煤等沉积物形成的一个层位。","note":"地质或采矿用语；煤层可说 a bed of coal 或 a coal bed。","example":{"id":"bed-geology-example-1","senseId":"bed-noun-geology","en":"The tunnel passes through a thin bed of coal.","zh":"这条隧道穿过一层薄煤层。","note":"这里的 bed 指煤形成的地层。"},"sourceIds":["wiktionary-bed-en","etymonline-bed"]}

{"id":"bed-noun-base","title":"机器底座；机床床身","meaning":"机器中承托、固定其他部件的坚固基座，如车床的床身。","note":"机械专业用语，常见于 machine bed、lathe bed 等表达。","example":{"id":"bed-base-example-1","senseId":"bed-noun-base","en":"The lathe has a heavy cast-iron bed.","zh":"这台车床有一个沉重的铸铁床身。","note":"bed 在这里指承托车床其他部件的结构。"},"sourceIds":[]}

{"id":"bed-noun-roadbed","title":"路基","meaning":"承托道路路面或铁路轨道的基础层。","note":"交通工程用语；也常见合成词 roadbed。","example":{"id":"bed-roadbed-example-1","senseId":"bed-noun-roadbed","en":"The flood washed away part of the railway bed.","zh":"洪水冲走了一部分铁路路基。","note":"railway bed 指轨道下面起承托作用的路基。"},"sourceIds":[]}

{"id":"bed-verb-intransitive-settle","title":"沉实；贴合稳固（不及物）","meaning":"材料逐渐沉实、形成稳固的一层，或机器部件逐渐贴合、磨合。","note":"常与 down 或 in 连用。bed down 可描述铺地材料沉实；bed in 可描述部件磨合，如 new brake pads bed in（新刹车片磨合）。","example":{"id":"bed-settle-example-1","senseId":"bed-verb-intransitive-settle","en":"The gravel will bed down over time.","zh":"这些碎石会随着时间推移逐渐沉实。","note":"这里没有宾语，是碎石本身逐渐沉降、稳定下来。"},"sourceIds":["wiktionary-bed-en"]}

sourceEvidence.text: Old English bedd already referred both to a sleeping or resting place and to a garden plot. The present word continues that Germanic history. River-bottom and geological-layer uses developed later. A proposed connection with digging and a hollowed sleeping place is explicitly challenged in the source; it should not be taught as a certain story about how people originally slept.
